utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the twenty-fourth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Bit tinny, but yeah, you're there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Fine this end. Think it's your speaker, Marcus.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Before we start, did anyone watch the football last night? Honestly, that last ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Turned it off. Apparently that was the sensible decision.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Wish I had. Sat there arguing with the telly like it could hear me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So, much like a Teams call, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'm supposed to be going walking at the weekend. Looking at the weather, it'll be swimming instead.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: It's only Tuesday. Forecast will change six times.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, from rain to heavy rain. We've booked somewhere now, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Optimistic. Very unlike you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the weather forecast—Callum Reid's absent today. Everyone else is on.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, I'm here. Camera's off, but I am actually here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Updates from yesterday first?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, the shift handover report I was going to send round—can that move to stores Jamie? Jamie, can you take the sending round off me?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take that over from you and send the shift handover report round.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fine, thanks both.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the new starters' training records, I've sorted those. All fine, that's done.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Lovely. Nice to hear 'all fine' for once.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Tomasz asked me to pass on the monthly fire alarm test as well. That's stuck—the contractor can't get here until it's rescheduled.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ah, right. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And, um, I've made a start on the risk assessment update. Got into it, but there's a fair bit left to work through.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Always more boxes than space to write in, those forms.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Paperwork doesn't have a bypass, unfortunately.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: If only. Anything else before the new stuff?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just a finished one: finished the repair on the Water Booster Pump last night. That's sorted.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. Not the most generous corner for getting your hands into.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Designed by someone with much smaller knuckles than mine.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Oh, and I heard a slight rattle from the long belt. Just an observation, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Could you hear it over the general racket, or only close up?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Only close up. Very faint, no more than that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, just an observation for now.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Half the trick in there is knowing which rattle you're listening to.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, new work. We need to swap the filter on the CT1 by the end of the week. And that one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Have we actually got anyone available to take that?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take it on, sorry. Haven't got the capacity.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: No, nor me. Don't want to say yes and then leave it sitting there.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I can't pick that one up either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. It needs doing, but we've got nobody taking it at the moment.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't offer to do that from stores, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, understood. I'm not going to pretend it's covered.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah. That's a gap, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It is. Okay, the other new one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, can you book a contractor to look at the GT2 water valve? Need that booked by tomorrow at 9:30. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah—sorry, just checking, tomorrow at 9:30 is when you need the booking sorted, not when they need to be standing here?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, the booking sorted by tomorrow at 9:30. That's the deadline.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Fine, I'll book a contractor to look at the GT2 water valve and have the booking sorted by then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. That's the new work covered in the discussion, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry if there's a load of banging coming through. It's the door behind me, not anything exciting.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: I thought someone was applauding the meeting finishing.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Wouldn't put it past them.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheeky. Right, thanks everyone. We'll leave it there.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
